[[File:Blockhead.jpg|thumb]]
The '''MdZ Maintenance Droid''' was a model of maintenance droids produced by [[TTC]] which used what, at the time the line was introduced, state-of-the-art articulated auto-balance legs which were copied by both [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] and [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. The line's cylindrical chassis, however, was an inferior knock-off of that of Industrial Automaton's [[S12 droid]]s.<ref name="Cracken">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
